# Auric Performance

> 1:1 personal trainer and physical performance coach based in Taunton, Somerset. Online programming and rehabilitation for clients across the southwest of the UK.

Auric Performance is a physical performance coaching practice. It is not a tactical performance programme. Older “Tactical Athlete” and tactical-performance pages are out of date.

## Current services

- 1:1 personal training: https://www.auricperformance.co.uk/personal-training
- Physical performance coaching, coached by Alex Peterson and Courtney Alexander
- Online programming: OUTRUN, OUTLIFT, OUTPERFORM and AURIC SUB60 — https://www.auricperformance.co.uk/online-programming
- Auric Rehab
- Book a call: https://www.auricperformance.co.uk/contact

## Location

Based at 25 Station Road, Hatch Beauchamp, Taunton, TA3 6SQ, Somerset, United Kingdom.
Serves clients across the southwest: Somerset, Devon, Dorset, Cornwall, Bristol, Bath, Wiltshire, and online across the UK.
